Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
neqsim.process.safety.release.NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, ProcessEquipmentInterface, ProcessElementInterface, CoupledReleaseSource, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface, LegacyLoadRepairable
public final class NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory extends ProcessEquipmentBaseClass implements CoupledReleaseSource
Opt-in rigid gas/liquid inventory with retained phase compositions and finite-rate interphase transfer.

Unlike ReleaseInventory, this unit never reflashes the committed component partition. It retains separate gas and liquid component masses, evaluates each as a forced homogeneous EOS phase, and solves one common pressure and temperature from total rigid volume and total internal energy. A provenance-required ReleaseInventoryInterphaseTransfer moves components in either direction across the live geometry area with donor limits. The phase-enthalpy difference is retained as a latent-energy diagnostic while the volume/internal- energy solve enforces the complete closed-system energy effect. Release withdrawal removes the selected phase composition and stagnation enthalpy. Candidate calls are committed atomically only after component, total-mass, volume and energy closure checks pass.

The initial implementation assumes thermal equilibrium between exactly one gas phase and exactly one oil, generic liquid or aqueous phase. It does not predict separate phase temperatures, nucleation delay, entrainment, population balance, wall thermal inertia, pipe waves or solid transport. Coefficients are prescribed sensitivity inputs and do not confer engineering qualification.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory

      public NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory(String name, SystemInterface initialFluid, double volumeM3, double diameterM, double dischargeCoefficient, double backPressurePa, ReleaseFlowModel releaseModel, double maxSubstepS, PhaseType withdrawalPhaseType, ReleaseInventoryPhaseGeometry geometry, ReleaseInventoryInterphaseTransfer interphaseTransfer)
      Creates an independently owned two-phase non-equilibrium inventory.
      Parameters:
      name - unique process-equipment name
      initialFluid - equilibrium initial fluid containing exactly one gas and one supported liquid phase
      volumeM3 - fixed vessel volume in m3; must equal the cylindrical geometry capacity
      diameterM - physical release opening diameter in m
      dischargeCoefficient - discharge coefficient in (0, 1]
      backPressurePa - constant absolute receiving pressure in Pa
      releaseModel - caller-selected release model; screening results are rejected
      maxSubstepS - largest explicit substep in s
      withdrawalPhaseType - explicit GAS, OIL, LIQUID or AQUEOUS release phase
      geometry - live cylindrical level/interface/opening geometry
      interphaseTransfer - prescribed two-way component-film closure

    • NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory

      public NonEquilibriumReleaseInventory(String name, SystemInterface initialFluid, double volumeM3, double diameterM, double dischargeCoefficient, double backPressurePa, double flowPathLengthM, double darcyFrictionFactor, ReleaseFlowModel releaseModel, double maxSubstepS, PhaseType withdrawalPhaseType, ReleaseInventoryPhaseGeometry geometry, ReleaseInventoryInterphaseTransfer interphaseTransfer, ReleaseInventoryHeatTransfer heatTransfer)
      Creates an independently owned two-phase non-equilibrium inventory with pipe and heat boundaries.
      Parameters:
      name - unique process-equipment name
      initialFluid - equilibrium initial fluid containing exactly one gas and one supported liquid phase
      volumeM3 - fixed vessel volume in m3; must equal the cylindrical geometry capacity
      diameterM - physical opening or pipe diameter in m
      dischargeCoefficient - discharge coefficient or full-bore area factor in (0, 1]
      backPressurePa - constant absolute receiving pressure in Pa
      flowPathLengthM - constant-area release path length in m; zero selects a short opening
      darcyFrictionFactor - caller-specified Darcy factor; zero selects a short opening
      releaseModel - caller-selected release model; screening results are rejected
      maxSubstepS - largest explicit substep in s
      withdrawalPhaseType - explicit GAS, OIL, LIQUID or AQUEOUS release phase
      geometry - live cylindrical level/interface/opening geometry
      interphaseTransfer - prescribed two-way component-film closure
      heatTransfer - explicit external heat boundary

    • getThermoSystem

      public SystemInterface getThermoSystem()
      Returns the selected phase used by the equipment-level thermodynamic accessor.

      A single SystemInterface cannot represent two independently retained compositions without reflashing them. Whole-inventory users must therefore use getGasPhase(), getLiquidPhase() and getBalance() rather than treating this selected-phase view as an equilibrium bulk state.

      Specified by:
      getThermoSystem in interface ProcessEquipmentInterface
